nodes.label: App Icon — Cute Potato Mascot with Notebook and Pencil

properties.description: Rounded potato character with a smiling face, holding an orange/red notebook in one hand and a pencil in the other. Warm orange-brown color palette on a light cream/off-white background. Friendly, playful, kawaii-adjacent illustration style.
